text: A one-page website for Brew Lab in Indiranagar, Bengaluru: menu with prices, opening hours, location, pre-order for pickup. Also add online payments, a blog with 5 articles, an Instagram feed, a photo gallery and lots of animations. Warm and modern, mobile-first.

@Adaptation Enough to start. Everything in the brief is kept. Prices, hours, address, photos, Instagram handle, payment gateway key and blog article facts are not in the brief, so they go in as marked placeholders. Payments will be a front-end checkout button only, since the site is one static file with no server.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 12 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Full charter scope prices at 150 on the rate card against a budget of 60, so I propose the core first: W1 page shell with menu, hours and location (35), and W2 pre-order with payment (25). That spends the full 60. Blog (50 for 5 posts), Instagram, gallery and animations are unfunded, and Identity will need to rule on cuts or a budget change.

proposal.name: Core page: nav, menu, hours, location
proposal.goal_gap: No page exists. Visitors cannot see the menu with prices, opening hours or location.
proposal.expected_outcome: One HTML file with a mobile-first warm and modern layout, a nav with section anchors, and menu (grouped, ₹ or marked price placeholders), 7-day opening hours and location (Indiranagar, Bengaluru, address placeholder, map link) sections.
proposal.completion_check: File has viewport meta tag, min-width media queries, nav anchors to menu, hours, location; menu items grouped by category each with ₹ price or marked placeholder; hours listed for all 7 days; location names Indiranagar, Bengaluru with a map link; every missing fact shows as [PLACEHOLDER: ...].

proposal.name: Pre-order for pickup with payment step
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot order for pickup or pay online.
proposal.expected_outcome: A pre-order form where visitors pick items and quantities, enter name, phone and pickup time, see a running total in ₹, then reach a CDN checkout or payment link step using a marked placeholder public key.
proposal.completion_check: Form has item and quantity inputs, name, phone and pickup time fields; running total updates on change; payment button or checkout uses a CDN script or link with [PLACEHOLDER: public payment key]; no secrets in the file.
